# Project Structure ## Directory Organization ``` simple-coffee-collections/ ├── app/ # Next.js App Router - Routes and pages │ ├── (app)/ # Authenticated app routes (route group) │ │ ├── layout.tsx # App layout with navigation │ │ └── page.tsx # Home page │ ├── (auth)/ # Authentication routes (route group) │ │ ├── layout.tsx # Auth layout (centered, minimal) │ │ ├── login/ # Login page │ │ └── signup/ # Signup page │ ├── globals.css # Global styles and Tailwind directives │ └── layout.tsx # Root layout (HTML wrapper) │ ├── components/ # Reusable React components │ ├── ui/ # Base UI components (design system) │ │ ├── Button.tsx # Button component with variants │ │ ├── Button.test.tsx # Unit tests for Button │ │ ├── Input.tsx # Input component with label │ │ └── Input.test.tsx # Unit tests for Input │ ├── LogoutButton.tsx # Feature-specific component │ └── LogoutButton.test.tsx # Component tests │ ├── lib/ # Business logic and utilities │ ├── actions/ # Server Actions (mutations) │ │ ├── auth.ts # Authentication actions (signIn, signUp, signOut) │ │ └── auth.test.ts # Server action tests │ ├── supabase/ # Supabase client configuration │ │ ├── server.ts # Server-side Supabase client │ │ ├── client.ts # Client-side Supabase client │ │ └── middleware.ts # Session update middleware │ ├── types/ # TypeScript type definitions │ │ └── database.types.ts # Supabase database types │ └── utils/ # Utility functions (future) │ ├── supabase/ # Supabase local development │ ├── config.toml # Supabase configuration │ ├── migrations/ # Database migration files │ │ └── 20251231000000_initial_schema.sql │ └── seed.sql # Seed data for local development │ ├── __tests__/ # Test utilities and fixtures │ ├── fixtures/ # Test data and mocks │ └── utils/ # Test helper functions │ ├── .claude/ # Claude Code configuration │ ├── agents/ # Custom agent definitions │ ├── skills/ # Project-specific skills │ └── settings.json # Claude settings │ ├── .spec-workflow/ # Specification workflow (MCP) │ ├── steering/ # Project steering documents │ ├── specs/ # Feature specifications │ └── templates/ # Document templates │ ├── middleware.ts # Next.js middleware (auth session) ├── next.config.ts # Next.js configuration ├── tailwind.config.ts # Tailwind CSS configuration ├── tsconfig.json # TypeScript configuration ├── jest.config.js # Jest testing configuration └── package.json # Project dependencies and scripts ``` ## Naming Conventions ### Files - **Pages/Routes**: `page.tsx`, `layout.tsx` (Next.js convention) - **Components**: `PascalCase.tsx` (e.g., `LoginForm.tsx`, `Button.tsx`) - **Server Actions**: `camelCase.ts` (e.g., `auth.ts`, `coffeeEvaluations.ts`) - **Utilities**: `camelCase.ts` (e.g., `dateUtils.ts`, `validation.ts`) - **Tests**: `[filename].test.tsx` or `[filename].test.ts` (co-located with source) - **Types**: `[name].types.ts` (e.g., `database.types.ts`) ### Code - **Components**: `PascalCase` (e.g., `LoginForm`, `CoffeeCard`) - **Functions/Hooks**: `camelCase` (e.g., `signIn`, `useAuth`, `formatDate`) - **Server Actions**: `camelCase` (e.g., `signUp`, `createCoffeeEvaluation`) - **Constants**: `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` (e.g., `EMAIL_REGEX`, `MAX_FILE_SIZE`) - **Types/Interfaces**: `PascalCase` (e.g., `ButtonProps`, `User`, `CoffeeEvaluation`) - **Variables**: `camelCase` (e.g., `user`, `coffeeList`, `isLoading`) ## Import Patterns ### Import Order 1. **React/Next.js imports** (framework) 2. **External dependencies** (third-party libraries) 3. **Internal modules** (absolute imports with `@/`) 4. **Relative imports** (same directory, parent directory) 5. **Type imports** (when separate from value imports) 6. **Style imports** (CSS modules, if used) ### Example: ```typescript // 1. Framework 'use client' import { useState } from 'react' import Link from 'next/link' // 2. External dependencies import { formatDistance } from 'date-fns' // 3. Internal modules (absolute imports) import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button' import { createCoffeeEvaluation } from '@/lib/actions/coffeeEvaluations' import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client' // 4. Relative imports import { validateRating } from '../utils/validation' // 5. Type imports import type { CoffeeEvaluation } from '@/lib/types/database.types' ``` ### Module/Package Organization - **Absolute imports**: Use `@/` alias for all imports from project root - **Path alias**: `@/` maps to project root (configured in `tsconfig.json`) - **Barrel exports**: Avoid - prefer explicit imports for better tree-shaking ## Code Structure Patterns ### Server Component Organization ```typescript // 1. Imports import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server' // 2. Metadata export (if page) export const metadata = { title: '...', description: '...' } // 3. Server Component (async allowed) export default async function Page() { // 3a. Data fetching const supabase = await createClient() const { data } = await supabase.from('...').select() // 3b. Return JSX return
...
} ``` ### Client Component Organization ```typescript // 1. 'use client' directive 'use client' // 2. Imports import { useState } from 'react' // 3. Type definitions interface Props { // ... } // 4. Component function export function Component({ ...props }: Props) { // 4a. Hooks const [state, setState] = useState() // 4b. Event handlers function handleClick() { ... } // 4c. Effects (if needed) useEffect(() => { ... }, []) // 4d. Render logic return
...
} ``` ### Server Action Organization ```typescript // 1. 'use server' directive 'use server' // 2. Imports import { redirect } from 'next/navigation' import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server' // 3. Constants (validation patterns, etc.) const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ // 4. Action functions export async function actionName(formData: FormData) { // 4a. Extract and validate input const field = formData.get('field') as string if (!field) return { error: 'Error message' } // 4b. Business logic const supabase = await createClient() const { error } = await supabase... // 4c. Error handling if (error) return { error: error.message } // 4d. Success (redirect or return) redirect('/success-page') } ``` ### UI Component Patterns ```typescript // 1. Imports import { type ReactNode, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react' // 2. Props interface extending HTML attributes interface ComponentProps extends HTMLAttributes { children: ReactNode variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' // Custom props } // 3. Component with default props export function Component({ children, variant = 'primary', className = '', ...props }: ComponentProps) { // 3a. Style composition const baseStyles = '...' const variantStyles = { ... } const combinedClassName = `${baseStyles} ${variantStyles[variant]} ${className}` // 3b. Return JSX return
{children}
} ``` ## Code Organization Principles 1. **Server Components First**: Use Server Components by default, Client Components only when needed (interactivity, hooks) 2. **Co-location**: Keep related files together - Components with their tests (`Button.tsx` + `Button.test.tsx`) - Feature-specific code in feature directories 3. **Separation of Concerns**: - **app/**: Routing and page-level data fetching - **components/**: Presentational components (UI) - **lib/actions/**: Business logic and mutations (Server Actions) - **lib/supabase/**: Data access layer - **lib/types/**: Type definitions 4. **Single Responsibility**: Each file has one clear purpose - One component per file - Related actions grouped in one file (e.g., all auth actions in `auth.ts`) 5. **Testability**: Components and actions designed for easy testing - Pure functions where possible - Clear input/output contracts - Minimal side effects ## Module Boundaries ### Route Groups (App Router) - **(app)**: Authenticated routes - require user session - **(auth)**: Public authentication routes - redirect if authenticated ### Dependency Direction ``` app/ → components/ → lib/ ↓ ↓ ↓ └────→ lib/actions/ → lib/supabase/ ``` - **app/** can import from **components/** and **lib/** - **components/** can import from **lib/** (types, utils) but NOT **lib/actions/** - **lib/actions/** can import from **lib/supabase/** and **lib/types/** - **lib/supabase/** is a leaf module (minimal dependencies) ### Public API vs Internal - **components/ui/**: Public, reusable components (design system) - **components/[Feature]**: Feature-specific components (may be internal) - **lib/actions/**: Public Server Actions (form handlers) - **lib/supabase/**: Internal (only accessed via lib/actions) ### Server vs Client Boundaries - **Server-only**: `lib/supabase/server.ts`, `lib/actions/` - **Client-only**: Components with `'use client'`, `lib/supabase/client.ts` - **Shared**: Type definitions, utilities (isomorphic) ## Code Size Guidelines ### File Size - **Components**: < 200 lines (split into smaller components if larger) - **Server Actions**: < 100 lines per action, < 300 lines per file - **Utilities**: < 150 lines per file ### Function/Method Size - **Server Actions**: < 50 lines per function - **Event Handlers**: < 30 lines (extract logic if longer) - **Utility Functions**: < 20 lines (single purpose) ### Component Complexity - **Max Props**: 10 props per component (use composition instead) - **Nesting Depth**: Max 4 levels of JSX nesting - **Hooks per Component**: < 5 hooks (split component if more) ## Documentation Standards ### Code Comments - **JSDoc for public APIs**: All exported functions/components - **Inline comments**: Complex business logic only - **No obvious comments**: Code should be self-documenting ### Example JSDoc: ```typescript /** * Validates and creates a new coffee evaluation * @param formData - Form data containing evaluation fields * @returns Success redirect or error object */ export async function createCoffeeEvaluation(formData: FormData) { // ... } ``` ### README Files - **Project root**: Setup instructions, project overview - **Major modules**: Document purpose and usage (when needed) - **CLAUDE.md**: Project principles and development guidelines ## Testing Patterns ### Test Co-location - Tests live next to source files - **Component tests**: `Button.test.tsx` next to `Button.tsx` - **Action tests**: `auth.test.ts` next to `auth.ts` ### Test Naming ```typescript describe('Component/Function Name', () => { it('should do something specific', () => { // Arrange // Act // Assert }) }) ``` ### Test Organization ```typescript // 1. Imports import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' import { Button } from './Button' // 2. Test suite describe('Button', () => { // 2a. Unit tests it('renders children', () => { ... }) // 2b. Variant tests it('applies primary variant styles', () => { ... }) // 2c. Interaction tests it('calls onClick when clicked', () => { ... }) // 2d. Edge cases it('disables button when loading', () => { ... }) }) ``` ## Future Structure Considerations ### As the project grows: - **app/(app)/coffee/**: Coffee evaluation routes - **app/(app)/profile/**: User profile routes - **components/coffee/**: Coffee-specific components - **lib/actions/coffee.ts**: Coffee CRUD actions - **lib/hooks/**: Custom React hooks - **lib/utils/**: Utility functions (validation, formatting) - **lib/constants/**: Shared constants (roast levels, etc.)
